issues.description: The Bitmap24::set method has inconsistent parameter order between the template header and the implementation in the template repository. In the template header (Bitmap24.hpp) the declaration lists parameters as (int i_x, int i_y, ...), but the implementation in Bitmap24.cpp defines the method as set(int i_y, int i_x, ...). This mismatch will cause a linker/compile error and confuses students about the expected row/column ordering (y vs x). The solution repository uses the (i_y, i_x) order (consistent with usage in main.cpp where bitmap.set(i, j, ...) is called), so the template header appears to be incorrect/unintentionally swapped.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the template header declaration match the implementation and usages by declaring Bitmap24::set with the same parameter order used in Bitmap24.cpp and main.cpp: void set(int i_y, int i_x, char i_r, char i_g, char i_b); (i.e., swap the parameters in the template header). This preserves the intended API and avoids compilation errors.
